spans.s: अप्नः [apnḥ] अप्नस् [apnas], अप्नस् n. [आप्-असुन् नुट् ह्रस्वश्च,
Work, sacrificial act or rite, any act.

To be obtained (used actively); [cf. L. ops]. -Comp. -स्थ a. superintending work (कर्मण्यधिकृत); (or m.) proprietor of an estate. -राजः lord of wealth or property, illustrious by means of works; directing works to be done (कर्मप्रेरक).
Poor. -नः [अप्नसे आदायकर्मणे वानं यस्य पृषो˚ सलोप Tv.]
N. of a Ṛiṣi in the family of or connected with Bhrtod;igu. यमप्नवानो भृगवो विरुरुचुः
अप्नस्वत् [apnasvat], a. Having (sacrificial) acts or works; productive.
